admin_password_reset_requests_completion.name: admin_password_reset_requests_completion_check
admin_password_reset_requests_completion.value: ("admin_password_reset_requests"."outcome" = 'pending' AND "admin_password_reset_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("admin_password_reset_requests"."outcome" <> 'pending' AND "admin_password_reset_requests"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

judge_sessions_reserved_user.name: judge_sessions_reserved_user
judge_sessions_reserved_user.where: "judge_sessions"."released_at" IS NULL AND "judge_sessions"."reserved_for_user_id" IS NOT NULL

match_invitations_side_check.name: match_invitations_side_check
match_invitations_side_check.value: ("match_invitations"."match_participant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "match_invitations"."participant_side" = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text]) AND "match_invitations"."kind" = 'player') OR ("match_invitations"."match_participant_id" IS NULL AND "match_invitations"."participant_side" IS NULL AND "match_invitations"."kind" = 'judge')

match_participants_guest_identity_snapsh.name: match_participants_guest_identity_snapshot_check
match_participants_guest_identity_snapsh.value: "match_participants"."guest_identity_id" IS NULL OR ("match_participants"."user_id" IS NULL AND "match_participants"."guest_first_name" IS NOT NULL AND "match_participants"."guest_last_name" IS NOT NULL AND "match_participants"."guest_avatar_key" IS NOT NULL)

matches_tournament_bracket_match_uid.name: matches_tournament_bracket_match_uid
matches_tournament_bracket_match_uid.where: "matches"."tournament_bracket_match_id" IS NOT NULL AND "matches"."tournament_id" IS NOT NULL

matches_playing_segment_requires_elapsed.name: matches_playing_segment_requires_elapsed_check
matches_playing_segment_requires_elapsed.value: "matches"."playing_segment_started_at" IS NULL OR "matches"."playing_elapsed_ms" IS NOT NULL

tournament_participants_guest_identity_s.name: tournament_participants_guest_identity_snapshot_check
tournament_participants_guest_identity_s.value: "tournament_participants"."guest_identity_id" IS NULL OR ("tournament_participants"."user_id" IS NULL AND "tournament_participants"."guest_first_name" IS NOT NULL AND "tournament_participants"."guest_last_name" IS NOT NULL AND "tournament_participants"."guest_avatar_key" IS NOT NULL)
